metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins that ship quality. sniff walks your running app and finds real bugs (accessibility, performance, and broken flows), with an optional source scan. ui-ux-suite audits design across 12 dimensions grounded in 24 named UX laws. recap-studio builds self-contained offline HTML explainers from any topic or coding session. aws-cost-audit reads your live AWS account read-only, attributes every dollar, and verifies prices live before recommending safe savings. goalify writes a self-contained, self-deleting /goal file so a fresh session runs and verifies a big coding task autonomously. Zero bloat. The tool plugins are dual-mode (install as a Claude Code plugin or as a standalone MCP server); aws-cost-audit and goalify are Claude Code skills (no MCP server).

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: AI-powered QA that walks your running app like a user, discovers its flows, and finds real bugs (accessibility, performance, and broken interactions). Auto-detects your dev server. A source scan is also available via `sniff scan`.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: Design audit tool. Scores projects across 12 dimensions (color, typography, a11y, layout) grounded in 24 named UX laws with primary-source citations. WCAG, APCA, OKLCH color science. Zero dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Generate beautiful, mobile-first one-page explainers in under 5 minutes. Builds self-contained, offline HTML pages from any topic or coding session, with deterministic heuristic checks that validate clarity, accessibility, and structure before you ship.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Read-only, evidence-first AWS cost audit. Reads your live AWS account, attributes every dollar, finds idle/orphaned/over-provisioned resources, verifies prices live (never hardcoded), and ships a safe, reversible, gated savings plan with confidence levels. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Set up a big coding task to run on its own. goalify scopes the work, locks the few real decisions, and writes a self-contained, self-deleting /goal file so a fresh full-context session executes the whole job and verifies every success criterion before deleting the file. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).
